title: Unweighted monotonicity identity: the case h ≡ 1 of the weighted identity (parent Step 1)
statement: Let (WMI) be the frozen statement of the sibling weighted_monotonicity_identity: for all n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, every rectifiable n-varifold V in E = ℝ^{n+ℓ} with weight μ_V, every U ⊆ E, H: E → E, h: E → ℝ, ξ ∈ E and σ, ρ ∈ ℝ, if n > 0, μ_V is finite on compact sets, dim T_xV = n for μ_V-a.e. x, x ↦ p_{T_xV} is μ_V-a.e. strongly measurable, U is open, V has generalized mean curvature H in U, h is C¹ on U, tsupport h ∩ B_ρ(ξ) ⊆ U and 0 < σ ≤ ρ, then (a) τ ↦ τ^{-(n+1)}∫_{B_τ(ξ)}⟨x−ξ, ∇^M h(x) + h(x)H(x)⟩dμ_V is integrable on (σ, ρ], (b) x ↦ h(x)q_ξ(x)/|x−ξ|ⁿ is μ_V-integrable on B_ρ(ξ)∖B_σ(ξ), and (c) ρ^{-n}∫_{B_ρ(ξ)}h dμ_V − σ^{-n}∫_{B_σ(ξ)}h dμ_V = ∫_{B_ρ(ξ)∖B_σ(ξ)} h q_ξ/|x−ξ|ⁿ dμ_V + ∫_{(σ,ρ]} τ^{-(n+1)}∫_{B_τ(ξ)}⟨x−ξ, ∇^M h + hH⟩dμ_V dτ. Let (GF) be: for every n > 0, ℓ and every V, μ_V is finite on compact sets, dim T_xV = n for μ_V-a.e. x, and x ↦ p_{T_xV} is μ_V-a.e. strongly measurable. Then (WMI) and (GF) imply (UI): for all n > 0, ℓ, V, open U, H such that V has generalized mean curvature H in U, ξ, and 0 < σ ≤ ρ with B_ρ(ξ) ⊆ U: (i) e(τ) := τ^{-(n+1)}∫_{B_τ(ξ)}⟨x−ξ, H(x)⟩dμ_V is integrable on (σ, ρ]; (ii) w_ξ(x) := q_ξ(x)/|x−ξ|ⁿ is μ_V-integrable on B_ρ(ξ)∖B_σ(ξ); (iii) ρ^{-n}μ_V(B_ρ(ξ)) − σ^{-n}μ_V(B_σ(ξ)) = ∫_{B_ρ(ξ)∖B_σ(ξ)} w_ξ dμ_V + ∫_{(σ,ρ]} e(τ)dτ. Here B_t(ξ) is the closed ball, q_ξ(x) = V.normalRadialSq ξ x, μ_V(B) is the real number V.weight.real B, and all integrals are Bochner integrals.
